label: TTS

shape.name: outbound-wave-ring-array
shape.description: Six entirely separated, gradually expanding point rings distributed along the horizontal X axis. No bowl, bottom, connecting skin, or interior spokes.
shape.silhouette: An outward wave train with large empty axial gaps; clear direction from small to large rings.
shape.label: 広がる波輪

motion.phaseMeaning: Discrete axial propagation phase: ring k has phase k/6. Points in the same ring brighten together; group is its exact ring index.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.suggestion: Brighten the six rings in order from the tiny source to the largest wavefront. Optional radial breathing is at most 1.0%, relative to each ring's own center; never slide or merge rings.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
